entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To connect to an agent, please stay on the line.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return a jersey. Order number is VF-921-550.
Okay, one moment while I pull up that order... VF-921-550. I see the ProFit Jersey here. Just to confirm, I'm speaking with the account holder?
Yes. Look, I'm short on time. Can I return it, yes or no?
I understand. I can certainly look into that right away for you. Is it a technical fault with the jersey or more of a preference issue?
It's the wrong size. The medium is just too tight across the shoulders. I need to exchange it.
Thank you for clarifying. Let me just check the return policy against your delivery date... okay, I see it was delivered 23 days ago. That's no problem at all, you're well within the 90-day window.
Okay, good. So what's the next step?

I can process that exchange for you right now. I also see you're a VIP member with us, so I'll go ahead and process this as an advanced exchange. We'll ship the new size out immediately, and I'm upgrading it to express shipping, on us.
Perfect. That's exactly what I needed. Send me the label.
I've just sent the prepaid return label to your email on file. Your new jersey should be with you in 1-2 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
